# JioMed Family Care

> JioMed Family Medicine Clinic is a physician-owned family medicine practice at 11213 Nall Ave Ste 100, Leawood, KS 66211.
> Dr. Ekta S. Patel, MD and Dr. Megha Teeka, MD, DABOM provide primary care for every age — same-day
> acute care, annual wellness exams, chronic disease management, in-office procedures, in-house
> diagnostics, medical weight management, concierge medicine and physician-led aesthetic medicine.

## Practice details

- Phone: (913) 291-0135
- Email: info@jiomedfamilycare.com
- Address: 11213 Nall Ave Ste 100, Leawood, KS 66211
- Hours: Monday to Friday, 8 am – 5 pm. Closed Saturday and Sunday.
- Booking: https://patientportal.advancedmd.com/157502/onlinescheduling/v2?streamlineOptions=2
- Patient portal: https://pp-wfe-101.advancedmd.com/157502/account/logon
- Insurance: all major plans accepted except Medicaid and Humana.
- Rating: 5.0 out of 5 across 8 Google reviews.

## Services

- [Acute Care Appointments](https://jiomedfamilycare.com/acute-care-appointments): Same-day care for sudden illness
- [Wellness Exams](https://jiomedfamilycare.com/wellness-exams): Annual physicals and preventive care
- [Chronic Disease Management](https://jiomedfamilycare.com/chronic-disease-management): Ongoing care plans that hold
- [Procedures](https://jiomedfamilycare.com/procedures): In-office dermatology and gynecology
- [Diagnostic &amp; Testing](https://jiomedfamilycare.com/diagnostic-testing-services): In-house labs with fast results
- [Weight Management](https://jiomedfamilycare.com/weight-management): Medical weight loss with Enara Health
- [Concierge Medicine](https://jiomedfamilycare.com/concierge-medicine): Direct access to your physician
- [Aesthetic Medicine](https://jiomedfamilycare.com/aesthetic-medicine): Physician-led cosmetic treatments

## Notes

- Concierge medicine membership: $40/month individual, $30/month additional adult, $10/month children 0–18.
- Weight management is delivered in partnership with Enara Health and led by a board-certified obesity medicine physician.
- For medical emergencies, call 911. This site is not monitored for emergencies.
